title: 2025 Annual Spending
body:
In 2025, I finished up my AA for my CS and Math degree at a community college and eventually transferred to a neighboring university for 2026.

During this time, I worked at a part-time food job for $20/hr for 25~32 hours per week.

I also had a 4-day trip to Lake Tahoe and a 2-month trip to Taiwan, Korea, and Vietnam.

Here are the expense distributions for the whole year.

### Income/Expenses

Income: 26,554

Expenses: 21,043

- 1,753 spent per month

### Monthly Expenses

![image.png](/images/uploads/image-4.png)

The one outlier in March is 4k tuition for college.

### Expense Distribution

![image.png](/images/uploads/image-3.png)

Rent:

- Jan~July: 650 (lived in the living room)
- Sept~Dec: 800 (small private room)

Transportation (incl. flights):

- Flights: 2511.89
- Rideshare (Uber, Lyft, etc): 139.87

no car currently

Fashion: Had a self-given monthly $100 balance I would invest in clothing

Myself/Hobbies:

- DJI Osmo Pocket 3: 741.15
- DMV, driver's license: 479.19

Friend: gifts/things for friends

Utilities: anything home-related (toilet paper, trash bags, water filter, etc)

Restaurants: Almost always only ate out with friends, never alone

### Conclusion

I actually had a lot of impulse purchases this year, which I hoped to overcome in the next year. 

I also did not begin tracking my investments/savings until mid-2026.

I had also skipped meals just to limit my discretionary spending.

Since then, I have split the categories to better represent my spending and have had a better overall outlook on money rather than it being a delicacy I cannot touch for my future validation.
